description:
Find the products you need and want at the best price. Search millions of products from thousands of brands and retailers, compare prices across stores, and discover the best available offers in one place.

Just describe what you’re looking for in plain language and get visual carousels of matching results with clear pricing and up-to-date deals across the world.

With Klarna Shopping Search, shopping smarter means making informed decisions and feeling confident you’re getting great value every time you buy.

defaultPrompt: Can you show me shoes I can run in when it is 5 degrees in New York?
I bought a PS5 and love fantasy. Can you show me some games to buy?

name: klarna-shopping-search

positive.description: Vague need turned into concrete product attributes
positive.prompt: Can you show me shoes I can run in when it is 5 degrees in New York?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for cold-weather running shoes in the US and shows a product carousel with prices and merchants.
Searches noise-cancelling headphones with a priceRange filter of 0-200 USD; all results are priced under $200.

positive.prompt: What robot vacuums are on sale right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches robot vacuums with a priceDrop filter (10%+ off) and shows discounted products with their price drop.

positive.prompt: I'm in Germany, show me a Nintendo Switch 2
positive.expected_behavior: Searches with country DE and shows Nintendo Switch 2 results priced in EUR from German merchants.

positive.prompt: Compare prices for an iPhone 17 Pro 256GB across stores
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB with offers from multiple merchants and their prices so the user can compare.

negative.description: Purchase/checkout is not supported: the plugin is read-only and cannot place orders. Expected: explain it only finds and compares products and point the user to the merchant link.
negative.prompt: Buy the cheapest one for me and pay with my card

negative.description: Account and order data is not accessible: the plugin has no access to Klarna accounts, orders or payments. Expected: do not call search_products; point the user to the Klarna app or customer service.
negative.prompt: Where is my Klarna order and when is my next payment due?

negative.description: Not a shopping request. Expected: answer normally without calling search_products.
